./main.go:33:9: p.items cannot be handed to a return without a copy: p is borrowed, so its value cannot be moved out
    in Go the copy would share p.items's memory, so a change through one is seen through the other;
    patina mode does not copy such values on its own, because a copy would change what the program does
    hand over a copy instead: slices.Clone(p.items)
